name: Sennett
summary: Landed-adjacent pocket near Potong Pasir / MacPherson gravity — quieter residential texture with mid-town access without full estate-hub intensity.
body: Sennett is the shortlist when low-rise calm and central-east adjacency matter more than MRT-doorstep living. The estate sits near Potong Pasir and MacPherson gravity with landed streets and selective walk-up / condo edges. Expats shortlist it for family layouts and a less transient feel than Kallang riverside towers. Watch-outs: last-mile to MRT, school-run traffic, and variable MA / CCTV culture on condo pockets. Compare with Boon Keng for NEL doorstep practicality, Geylang East for food density, and Potong Pasir when you want the named station estate.
bestFor: people testing ActiveSG holiday camps nearby
watchOuts: Walk to MRT can be the tax
Fewer 24/7 amenity options than hub towns
Condo CCTV / visitor-app rules vary estate by estate
housingMix: Landed streets with selective walk-up and condo edges.
commuteNotes: Nearest MRT gravity toward Potong Pasir / Tai Seng / MacPherson depending on block. Test a weekday last-mile before you LOI.
